terminal_objective: Create durable, truthful external evidence surfaces for the frozen Hardware Splicer candidate, cross the physical boundary only with revision-bound measurements, and obtain public technical evaluation without inventing authority or dependencies.
hard_nonclaims: No board has been fabricated, assembled, powered, or physically tested.
Physical correctness and production readiness are unproven.
No independent evaluator, manufacturer, user, or reviewer has validated the candidate.
No DOI, OSHWA certification, venue acceptance, or benchmark result exists until a real external record is captured.

workstreams.objective: Create a citable, independently preserved artifact without changing the frozen release.
exit_criteria: Release manifest binds commit, tag, assets, and hashes.
Every included object has origin and license classification.
Archive rebuild is deterministic.
Public record preserves PACKAGED_NOT_PHYSICAL.
Real DOI and SWHID are recorded only after issuance.

workstreams.objective: Make creator-controlled hardware, software, and documentation eligible for OSHWA self-certification.
exit_criteria: Creator-controlled scopes are explicitly licensed.
Third-party scopes are distinguished.
Editable sources, BOM, build information, and revision are public.
OSHWA record exists before any certification claim or logo use.

workstreams.objective: Cross the physical boundary through ordinary procurement and revision-bound tests.
exit_criteria: Fabricated unit identity is recorded.
Cold inspection and continuity are receipted.
Controlled power and OE bring-up are receipted.
Read-only 0x9F result is bound to procedure and revision.
A new artifact version is issued rather than mutating the frozen candidate.

workstreams.objective: Convert the frozen engineering system into a clear, credible, reproducible product package for each target audience without claim drift.
exit_criteria: An unfamiliar technical reader can state what HS is, what is proven, and what is unproven after the first screen.
Every outward claim maps to canonical evidence.
Quickstart, links, hashes, downloads, and reproduction commands are tested.
The primary demo runs offline.
Audience packages share one evidence spine while answering audience-specific questions.
PACKAGED_NOT_PHYSICAL remains prominent.

workstreams.objective: Obtain technically relevant public evaluation and reusable external receipts.
Measure whether evidence gating reduces unsupported acceptance while preserving useful completion.

publication_decision.rule: Select one substantially overlapping archival manuscript at a time.

branches.VTS: Choose when test and validation methodology is the strongest contribution and official deadline, registration, and attendance obligations are acceptable.
branches.DAC_RESEARCH: Choose when quantitative agentic EDA novelty is strong enough for a finished six-page archival manuscript.
branches.DATE_LBR: Choose for a compact late or preliminary result when overlap policy permits.
branches.ETS: Choose when fail-closed evidence semantics and dependability form a distinct stronger contribution.
branches.DAC_ENGINEERING: Choose when system integration and demonstrated engineering evidence are stronger than research novelty.
